add_library(dodev_journal_core STATIC src/RemoteJournal.cpp src/JournalTable.cpp src/JournalExport.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_journal_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(dodev_journal_core PUBLIC Threads::Threads dodev_services)
target_compile_features(dodev_journal_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
# Optional plugin dependency: do not make the entire editor fail without SQLite.
find_package(SQLite3 QUIET)
if(SQLite3_FOUND)
    target_link_libraries(dodev_journal_core PUBLIC SQLite::SQLite3)
    target_compile_definitions(dodev_journal_core PRIVATE DODEV_JOURNAL_SQLITE=1)
    message(STATUS "Remote Journal: SQLite export enabled")
else()
    message(STATUS "Remote Journal: SQLite export disabled (install SQLite3 development libraries)")
endif()
add_library(dodev_remote_journal_plugin MODULE src/RemoteJournalPlugin.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_remote_journal_plugin PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
set(DODEV_JOURNAL_BUILD_DIR "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/remote-journal")
set(DODEV_JOURNAL_INSTALL_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/remote-journal")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_JOURNAL_BUILD_DIR}")
set_target_properties(dodev_remote_journal_plugin PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "dodev_remote_journal_plugin"
 LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_JOURNAL_BUILD_DIR}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_JOURNAL_BUILD_DIR}")
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
 set_target_properties(dodev_remote_journal_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${DODEV_JOURNAL_BUILD_DIR}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${DODEV_JOURNAL_BUILD_DIR}")
endforeach()
configure_file(plugin.json "${DODEV_JOURNAL_BUILD_DIR}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
install(TARGETS dodev_remote_journal_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${DODEV_JOURNAL_INSTALL_DIR}" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${DODEV_JOURNAL_INSTALL_DIR}")
install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${DODEV_JOURNAL_INSTALL_DIR}")
add_custom_command(TARGET dodev_remote_journal_plugin POST_BUILD COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E echo "[DoDevEditor][Journal][build] $<TARGET_FILE:dodev_remote_journal_plugin>")
install(CODE "message(STATUS \"[DoDevEditor][Journal][install] \${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${DODEV_JOURNAL_INSTALL_DIR}\")")
